en.hubeali: H 14808 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws said,

‘I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence and a man asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man from whom something comes out due to his anger, will Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Hold him responsible for it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is more benevolent than Tying down His<sup>azwj</sup> servant’. And in a copy from Abu Al-Hassan The First<sup>asws</sup>: (which says Allah<sup>azwj</sup> does not) ‘Coerce His<sup>azwj</sup> servant’.
en.sarwar: 361. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said,

‘I was in his (a.s.) presence and a man asked him (a.s.) about a man from whom something comes out due to his anger, will Allah (azwj) Hold him responsible for it?’ So he (a.s.) said: ‘Allah (azwj) is more benevolent than Tying down His (azwj) servant’. And in a copy from Abu Al-Hassan The First (a.s.): (which says Allah (azwj) does not) ‘Coerce His (azwj) servant’.
